note: Set A repeats the same facts several times (W8X10 three times, 11"X3/8" plates four times, GRADE LEVEL 0" twice) and adds unsupported conditions or misbindings: the 2'-9 1/16" dimension is given invented conditions ("inner dimension", "from grade level to lower plate"), 1/4" is called a gap/offset on the West Roof Cantilever and a slope on the Floor Overhang, and HSS4X4X1/4 is bound to the East Roof Cantilever although it is labeled in the C5/A4 details. Set B keeps the elevations (GRADE LEVEL 0", FIRST FLR 2'-4", T.O. STEEL 11'-4"), the plate/angle/HSS sections and the title-block and revision data correctly, with fewer invented conditions. Set B is not clean either: its two "slope 1/4"" claims misread a weld/plate symbol, the support-plate thickness of 1/4" rests on a stitched-together quote (the plate is 11"X3/8"), and two bare "thickness 1/4"" claims are unbound. On balance B carries more correct, well-bound facts and fewer misreadings than A.
